## HttpsOptions {#Sisk_Cadente_HttpHost_HttpsOptions}

Gets or sets the HTTPS options for secure connections. Setting an [HttpsOptions](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Cadente.HttpsOptions.md) object in this
property, the [HttpHost](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Cadente.HttpHost.md) will use HTTPS instead of HTTP.

```csharp
public HttpsOptions? HttpsOptions { get; set; }
```

[HttpsOptions](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Cadente.HttpsOptions.md)?
